aboutMe.title: Front-end Developer
paragraphs: Based in Azerbaijan 🇦🇿, I am an experienced Front-end Developer with a strong background in crafting engaging and responsive user interfaces. Proficient in a range of web technologies, I am dedicated to delivering visually appealing and user-friendly web applications that enhance the user experience and drive business growth.

experience.description: Lead developer for multiple large-scale government and financial projects. Key projects include the Internet Tax Administration, VAT Bank System, and MDM.

As a Project Manager, I successfully led and managed a dynamic team of over 50 talented developers, testers, and analysts. Our primary focus was the conceptualization, design, and implementation of a cutting-edge Tax System aimed at simplifying and optimizing the tax payment process for taxpayers.

In 2016, I founded a tech company and entered a highly competitive market alongside major industry players. Together with my team, we successfully delivered two key projects: an Online Educational Monitoring System for schools and a Master Data Management solution that centralized data across multiple systems.

Over five years, I progressed from Operations Manager to Executive Director at a private transportation company. I managed a fleet of vehicles and a team of drivers, delivering ad-hoc transportation and guest meet-and-greet services for clients including BP, Statoil, and Amec.
